newsitem.title: USA: Zapata bids $70 million for rest of Envirodyne. [CORRECTED 23:27 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Zapata bids $70 million for rest of Envirodyne. [CORRECTED 23:27 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects the headline and the text to show the bid was $70 million not $378 million.)

Zapata Corp. on Wednesday said it launched a $70 million cash-and-stock bid for Envirodyne after the food packaging company advised shareholders against voting for Zapata's proposed slate of directors.

Zapata, Envirodyne's largest shareholder with a 40.4 percent stake, said the offer, which equals $8 a share, represents a 32 percent premium over Envirodyne's closing price of $6.0625 Tuesday and values Envirodyne at $640 million.
Envirodyne shareholders would receive $4 a share in cash and $4 in Zapata common stock, based on an exchange ratio to be determined, the company said.
Wall Street, however, was not impressed.
After initially being halted on the Nasdaq market, Environdyne's stock added 43.75 cents to $6.50, which was still well below Zapata's bid price.
Zapata's stock, which also had a delayed start on the New York Stock Exchange, slipped 12.5 cents to $4.25.
Houston-based Zapata said its proposal was conditioned on its slate of nominees being elected at Envirodyne's annual meeting later this week.
The total transaction values Envirodyne, based in the Chicago suburb of Oak Brook, Ill., at approximately $640 million in stock and debt, Zapata said.

"The Envirodyne board has questioned our intentions and motives in seeking to nominate three directors at the upcoming annual meeting," said Avram Glazer, president and chief executive officer of Zapata. "We are willing to acquire the entire company for a handsome premium.
"If Envirodyne's board is truly interested in advancing stockholders' interests, they should embrace our proposal and move quickly toward its successful completion."
There was no immediate response from Envirodyne.
Zapata, which produces oil, natural gas and fish meal and oil, said in March it aimed to reposition itself as a multi-industry company.
